description: The scenario or setting of an exchanged document, such as its business process application context.

applicationSpecifiedParameter.description: An application context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

bIMSpecifiedParameter.description: A Business Information Master (BIM) context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

businessProcessSpecifiedParameter.description: A business process context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

guidelineSpecifiedParameter.description: A guideline context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

messageStandardSpecifiedParameter.description: The message standard document context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

processingTransactionDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value of the processing of a transaction for this exchanged document context.

scenarioSpecifiedParameter.description: A scenario context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

specifiedTransactionId.description: The identifier of a specified transaction in this exchanged document context.

subsetSpecifiedParameter.description: A subset context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.

testIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this exchanged document context is a test.

userSpecifiedParameter.description: A user specified document context parameter specified for this exchanged document context.
